verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs show Financial Connections is driven programmatically: a server returns a client_secret, there is a relink API, and webhook events cover account linking and data refreshes. Stripe's official MCP server also exposes the Stripe API to AI agents. However, the pack has no Financial Connections API reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, so the depth of the public API is not fully evidenced. missing for 10: a cited API reference for Financial Connections resources (accounts, sessions, balance/ownership/transaction refresh endpoints), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch the authentication flow from your client using the client_secret returned by your server
Use the relink API to help your user reconnect their inactive account.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
